# @stackline/ansicolors {{PACKAGE_VERSION}}

Zero-dependency ANSI foreground and background wrappers preserving the exact ansicolors 0.3.2 contract.

Install: npm install @stackline/ansicolors
Alias migration: npm install ansicolors@npm:@stackline/ansicolors@^1.0.2
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/ansicolors/
Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-ansicolors
License: MIT

The package provides CommonJS, native ESM, accurate TypeScript 3.9+ declarations, browser bundles, 32 color methods, and open/close escape maps.
